notes: A run of chambers where a gate opens once the NPCs in the room are dead, ending at a boss, is Action's linear arena chain rather than RPG — there is no town, no stats and no world outside the dungeon, and RPG's shapes are all world-scale. Shape is rooms-sequence for the three chambers plus boss room the author specified, joined by corridors and worked through in order; because the whole map is interior there is no outside-to-inside transition to pay for, so it stays on P0. Hack & Slash is the preset that already carries the door-seals-until-cleared gate as arena-lockin and the per-chamber enemies as spawner-npc; I dropped its destructible-cluster because the author described each chamber precisely as enemies plus a gate and breakable cover would be set dressing they never asked for. Deciding without a user: the boss chamber is where the run ends, and the swords and armor from the boss are loot drops rather than anything the layout places, so they carry no option.
